attrs.why_open: Nothing derives an instrument's origins from the instrument. Deriving TOOL-NODE from the fact that a witness is a .mjs file executed by node is mechanical and was not done; deriving ASM-SUBSTRATE-INTEGRITY is the same move. Until then the floor is a convention that happens to be true. NOTE the error direction: under-declaration can only make the overlap smaller, so it cannot make the claim false — it can make it uninformative.
